Subject: Request: last-dash trial surge for NimbleWorks (EOQ close)

Ben / Monica,

Quick ask — NimbleWorks (deal DW-2027-063) is in an active POC and just finished round 1 of API integration tests. They hit a throughput bottleneck during the second workload run and need additional tokens to run a final 2x stress pass this week. Sales signal is strong: CM has confirmed product fit and legal indicates procurement will be ready to move if the final trial passes. ARR upside ~ $220k ARR if we convert this quarter.

What I'm requesting: a one-off trial surge of 30k tokens + a 45-day trial extension, conditional on them completing the final integration test and signing the MSA within 30 days of test completion. The customer asked for 50k — I think 30k is a reasonable compromise given margin and precedent.

Attachments: nimbleworks_poc_metrics.xlsx (POC telemetry), MVP-integration-plan.pdf (what they'd run).

If you can approve up to 30k, I will send a formal conditional offer to Sam and loop procurement. If you want a finance stamp, we can route to sales-credits@redwood.com but I wanted quick eyes first.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Marcus —

I reviewed the metrics quickly. Good signal from usage patterns. We can authorize up to 30k tokens as a one-off for conversion play, with two caveats: 1) Customer signs the conditional MSA (template OK'd by legal) within 30 days of completing the additional test; 2) Finance signs off on the one-off credit issuance (please cc sales-credits@redwood.com when you send the customer offer).

I attached the approval_matrix.pdf for our records (internal). If procurement pushes for 50k, we should offer 30k + a follow-on credit tied to usage milestones post-purchase, not a lump extra.

Approve: Marcus may proceed to customer with a 30k token offer and 45-day extension.

Hi Sam —

Thanks for walking through the integration notes earlier. Quick follow-up: we can provide a one-off trial surge to ensure your stress pass completes this week. Offer below — conditional on the final test run and a signed MSA within 30 days of completion.

Offer: 30,000 token credit applied to your trial, plus a 45-day trial extension.
Conditions:
- Run the final integration stress test within 7 days and confirm results (MVP-integration-plan.pdf attached).
- Sign the Redwood MSA (we can route an editable DocuSign) within 30 days of the test results.
- If NimbleWorks needs >30k tokens to complete the test, we will evaluate a usage-tied credit after the test (not a guaranteed top-up).

Next steps: if that works, confirm and provide the procurement contact (cc'd here) and we'll circulate a concise conditional offer + DocuSign package and loop sales-credits for final stamping. Ben has pre-approved up to 30k; finance will do the final release upon DocuSign execution.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — this is a good moment to get you fully onboarded this quarter.

—Marcus
